            <section ID="i4i_OTC_Active_Ingredient_id_afdf8e3f-85da-41be-80c0-4b8306943b30">

               <code code="55106-9" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - ACTIVE INGREDIENT SECTION"/>
               <title>Active ingredient (in each chewable tablet)  </title>
               <text>
                  <paragraph>Aspirin 81 mg (NSAID*)</paragraph>

               </text>

            <section ID="i4i_OTC_Purpose_id_32e51c91-bd51-46f8-8e37-e5b52a051a08">
               <id root="113307a9-ab6a-45ac-87aa-6519ecdd4cd1"/>
               <code code="55105-1" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - PURPOSE SECTION"/>
               <title>Purpose</title>
               <text>
                  <paragraph>Pain reliever</paragraph>
               </text>
               <effectiveTime value="20120816"/>
            </section>

            <section ID="i4i_indications_id_f011e5c9-2be9-4202-84b6-157e406b9e6b">
               <id root="eaeb6f4d-0d77-4fb7-b172-b610438e4deb"/>
               <code code="34067-9" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="INDICATIONS & USAGE SECTION"/>
               <title>Uses</title>
               <text>
                  <paragraph>for the temporary relief of minor aches and pains</paragraph>
               </text>
               <effectiveTime value="20120816"/>
            </section>
         </component>
         <component>
            <section ID="i4i_warnings_id_104558b3-2585-4f0d-af3e-7bfde8c84611">
               <id root="cd8e5385-93f2-4dbb-9ee9-07dfd81e12ea"/>
               <code code="34071-1" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="WARNINGS SECTION"/>
               <title>Warnings</title>
               <text>
                  <paragraph>
                     <content styleCode="bold">Reye’s syndrome:</content> Children and teenagers who have or are recovering from chicken pox or flu-like symptoms should not use this product. When using this product, if changes in behavior with nausea and vomiting occur, consult a doctor because these symptoms could be an early sign of Reye’s syndrome, a rare but serious illness.</paragraph>
                  <paragraph>
                     <content styleCode="bold">Allergy alert:</content> Aspirin may cause a severe allergic reaction which may include: </paragraph>
                  <list listType="unordered">
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>hives</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>facial swelling  </item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>asthma (wheezing)  </item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>shock</item>
                  </list>
                  <paragraph>
                     <content styleCode="bold">Stomach bleeding warning:</content> This product contains an NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding. The chance is higher if you</paragraph>
                  <list listType="unordered">
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>are age 60 or older</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>have had stomach ulcers or bleeding problems</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>take a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>take other drugs containing prescription or nonprescription NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, or others)</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>have 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>take more or for a longer time than directed </item>
                  </list>
               </text>
               <effectiveTime value="20240905"/>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Do_not_use_id_ff636ddb-338e-487c-b563-70c989fa4797">
                     <id root="261e84a1-2302-41d7-8e5f-1f555624e87b"/>
                     <code code="50570-1" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - DO NOT USE SECTION"/>
                     <title>Do not use</title>
                     <text>
                        <list listType="unordered">
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>if you have ever had an allergic reaction to any other pain reliever/fever reducer</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>for at least 7 days after tonsillectomy or oral surgery unless directed by a doctor</item>
                        </list>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20120816"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Ask_Doctor_id_ed0e0a0a-5c99-4ee9-a755-3d6e88e8ef22">
                     <id root="38a57dca-5f67-4941-8b8f-3ba66b26cc16"/>
                     <code code="50569-3" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - ASK DOCTOR SECTION"/>
                     <title>Ask a doctor before use if </title>
                     <text>
                        <list listType="unordered">
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>stomach bleeding warning applies to you</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>you have a history of stomach problems, such as heartburn</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>you have high blood pressure, heart disease, liver cirrhosis, or kidney disease</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>you are taking a diuretic</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>you have asthma</item>
                        </list>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20120816"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Ask_Doctor_Pharmacist_id_b76d9230-99cf-4881-b647-1f0ebc35ea9d">
                     <id root="768c97d4-c181-4124-8a6d-32fc38ce206d"/>
                     <code code="50568-5" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - ASK DOCTOR/PHARMACIST SECTION"/>
                     <title>Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are</title>
                     <text>
                        <paragraph>taking a prescription drug for </paragraph>
                        <list listType="unordered">
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>gout </item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>diabetes </item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>arthritis</item>
                        </list>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20181008"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Stop_Use_id_d2a3beec-0133-4ee3-8960-cd8179bfdc2c">
                     <id root="ab420890-cb51-474e-ae9d-44162235807a"/>
                     <code code="50566-9" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - STOP USE SECTION"/>
                     <title>Stop use and ask a doctor if </title>
                     <text>
                        <list listType="unordered">
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>an allergic reaction occurs. Seek medical help right away.</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>you experience any of the following signs of stomach bleeding:<list listType="unordered">
                                 <item>
                                    <caption>•</caption>feel faint</item>
                                 <item>
                                    <caption>•</caption>vomit blood</item>
                                 <item>
                                    <caption>•</caption>have bloody or black stools</item>
                                 <item>
                                    <caption>•</caption>have stomach pain that does not get better</item>
                              </list>
                           </item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>redness or swelling is present</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>new symptoms occur</item>
                           <item>
                              <caption>•</caption>ringing in the ears or a loss of hearing occurs</item>
                        </list>
                        <paragraph>These could be signs of a serious condition</paragraph>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20240905"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Pregancy_Breastfeeding_id_c39b0266-fd1a-44d6-8c0c-fe4947a0b37a">
                     <id root="7ff513fe-4e7e-4a21-9ec1-9101e1b2755d"/>
                     <code code="53414-9" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION"/>
                     <title>If pregnant or breast-feeding,</title>
                     <text>
                        <paragraph>ask a health professional before use. It is especially important not to use aspirin at 20 weeks or later in pregnancy unless definitely directed to do so by a doctor because it may cause problems in the unborn child or complications during delivery.</paragraph>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20240905"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
               <component>
                  <section ID="i4i_OTC_Keep_Away_Children_id_8fef8202-5af4-4cf2-877b-942dccfd0b25">
                     <id root="46d0bf50-ea6f-4050-ac0d-f6a26a2e72eb"/>
                     <code code="50565-1" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION"/>
                     <title>Keep out of reach of children.</title>
                     <text>
                        <paragraph>In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222).</paragraph>
                     </text>
                     <effectiveTime value="20181008"/>
                  </section>
               </component>
            </section>
         </component>
         <component>
            <section ID="i4i_dosage_admin_id_75adf62d-6025-4edd-8c67-7c4e6dc33550">
               <id root="20f83593-4a40-4574-ab34-69045d9e28b2"/>
               <code code="34068-7" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION SECTION"/>
               <title>Directions</title>
               <text>
                  <list listType="unordered">
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>drink a full glass of water with each dose</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>adults and children 12 years and over: take 4 to 8 chewable tablets every 4 hours not to exceed 48 tablets in 24 hours unless directed by a doctor</item>
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>children under 12 years: consult a doctor</item>
                  </list>
               </text>
               <effectiveTime value="20240905"/>
            </section>
         </component>
         <component>
            <section ID="i4i_storage_id_c1a4d897-6a69-4563-8f56-5194fbbe7544">
               <id root="eab1ca00-67dd-4a43-8720-ed8398a4506f"/>
               <code code="44425-7" codeSystem="2.16.840.1.113883.6.1" displayName="STORAGE AND HANDLING SECTION"/>
               <title>Other information</title>
               <text>
                  <list listType="ordered">
                     <item>
                        <caption>•</caption>store at 20-25°C (68-77°F)</item>
                  </list>
               </text>
               <effectiveTime value="20181008"/>
            </section>
